forecast-period.text: A high pressure system over the Bight slowly drifts over SA on Saturday to be centred over the eastern states by Sunday. A weak front embedded in the southwesterly flow around the high, clips the southeast early Saturday morning. A low pressure system and associated trough move into the far west later Sunday and then moves across the state on Monday an d out over the eastern states by later Tuesday. Another ridge of high pressure moves into the west later Tuesday
For latest warnings go to www.bom.gov.au, subscribe to RSS feeds, call 1300 659 210* or listen for warnings on relevant TV and radio broadcasts.
* Calls to 1300 numbers cost around 27.5c incl. GST, higher from mobiles or public phones.

Early morning fog about the agricultural area and adjacent West Coast and Pastoral districts. Possible early morning frost about the Flinders and Mid North districts. Isolated light showers about the Southern Agricultural Area, most likely about windward coasts and ranges during the morning. Isolated showers and possible thunderstorms about the far northwest. Maximum temperatures below average, tending near average about the Southern Agricultural Areas. Southwest to southeasterly winds, westerly in the southeast at first, and tending east to northeasterly in the west.

Showers about the far north, contracting northeastwards and clearing during the evening. Isolated light showers about the agricultural area, mainly about windward coasts and ranges. Southwest to southeasterly winds, tending westerly in the southeast.

Early morning fog and possible early morning frost mainly on and east of the ranges and in the southeast. Showers and possible thunderstorms about the northwest, extending across the west during the day, tending to rain about the far northwest. Maximum temperatures below average about the north, tending near average about the south. Northeast to northwesterly winds, freshening in the west, and tending southerly in the far southwest later.

Showers extending statewide, tending to rain about parts of the pastoral districts, possibly extending into the West Coast and Flinders districts. Possible thunderstorms about the north and west. Maximum temperatures below average, remaining above average about the far northeast and southeast. Freshening north to northwesterly winds ahead of a fresh and gusty southwest to southerly change extending from the west.

text.p: Showers extending statewide, tending to rain about parts of the pastoral districts. Possible thunderstorms about the north and west. Maximum temperatures generally below average. North to northwesterly winds ahead of a fresh southwest to southerly change in the west, extending throughout during the morning then easing during the day.

Cumulative rainfall totals to the end of Tuesday: Broadly 1 to 5 mm, increasing to 5 to 15 mm about the Northern Agricultural Area and parts of the Pastoral districts, increasing further to 15 to 30 mm about parts of the west coast, southern and northwestern parts of the Pastoral districts and parts of the northern agricultural area. Isolated falls of 25 to 50 mm are also possible in these areas and with thunderstorms.
